title: exagium: one queue after the whole-project audit (2026-11-17)
intro: Built from six skill-group audits (A security, B tests/bugs/state, C structure, D claims, E agents/free compute, F ML/binaries), a separate verification pass (S2: 15 of 16 high-impact items confirmed by reproduction, 1 partly right), and the 2026-11-13 audit and handoffs. Severity is after S2 corrections. Source of truth: queue.json; render with render.py. Every open item declares what it writes ('touches': files, paths, branches; reads don't count); render.py refuses an open item without it and lists items in different batches that touch the same thing, so overlaps show up as items are added.
